entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I'm calling about an order I received. I need to make a return.
You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Steve. I can certainly help you with a return. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, the name is Anya Sharma, and the order number is VF-921-884-B.
Thank you, Anya. One moment... Okay, I see your account. Wow, you're one of our platinum VIP members! Thanks for being with us for so long. And you're looking to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor?
That's the one. It's just not what I was looking for.

Okay, **no problem** at all. Let's see... the delivery date was 18 days ago. That's perfectly fine. You're well inside the **90 days** we have for our return window, so we can get this sorted out for you right away.
Oh, wonderful. So you can process that for me now?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return and emailed a prepaid **return label** to the address on file. And just as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've gone ahead and applied free expedited shipping to your next order.
That's very kind of you, Steve. Thank you.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see the full refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's perfect. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome, Anya. Thanks for calling VeloFit and have a great day!
